data.one_liner: Discover open ports, devices on a subnet, and perform network scanning.
data.what_it_does: Network Tools helps you scan local subnets to discover active hosts and connected devices, scan ports on a single device or range, and perform mDNS device searches. It supports concurrent scans, progress callbacks, and running scans in background isolates.
use_when: You need to discover all active devices on the local subnet.
You need to scan ports on a target IP address or range.
You need to resolve mDNS devices and retrieve device information.
avoid_when: You are building web applications (requires Dart native/mobile/desktop platforms).
You only need high-level HTTP requests rather than raw TCP/IP or network discovery.
strengths: Fast subnet and port scanning with bounded concurrency.
Supports running scans in background isolates to keep the UI responsive.
Provides streaming results as ports or hosts resolve.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific permissions and configurations (such as local network access on iOS or multicast locks on Android).
Some advanced features or permissions vary by operating system platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing network tools with your app document directory in the main function. Android requires a MulticastLock and location permissions for Wi-Fi details; iOS requires multicast networking entitlement and local network permission.
